newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq extends record run, cracks 1500 mark.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq extends record run, cracks 1500 mark.

text.p: The Nasdsaq composite extended its run of record closing highs to a seventh session on Friday, with a rally in computer-related stocks driving the index through the 1500 mark.
The Nadsaq composite ended up about 12 points at 1503, as computer, semiconductor and Internet-related stocks rallied.
"It was pretty much across the board," said James Volk, director of equity trading at Jensen Securities.
Among the big winners was Atmel Corp, which jumped 4-1/8 to 32-5/8 after executives at the computer chipmaker said they expect new products to boost earnings in the second half of the year.

Dell Computer Corp jumped 9-3/8 to 138, leading a rally among computer makers after strong quarterly earnings from Compaq Computer Corp were taken as a sign of strength in the group. Even embattled Apple Computer Corp rose 1-15/16 to 15-3/16.
High-speed Internet access company At Home Corp leaped 6-1/2 to 17 in its first day of trading.
The most active Nasdaq issue was MCI Communications Corp, which sank 7-3/8 to 35 after a profit warning.
